name: duopore-public-explicit-kpi-threshold-flags
description: Flag business measures that fall outside the limits you choose, so you know what to review.

interface.longDescription: Flag business measures that fall outside the limits you choose, so you know what to review. Enter values and their lower and upper limits. See which need attention and which are within range; a value on the limit is within range. This checks your rules only. It does not learn normal patterns, find causes or provide live alerts.
defaultPrompt: Flag these business numbers when they fall outside my limits.
Which values are within the lower and upper limits I set?

positive.prompt: Use KPI Threshold Flags with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"metrics":[{"id":"K1","label":"Response hours","value":8,"lowerBound":0,"upperBound":6},{"id":"K2","label":"Weekly reviews","value":10,"lowerBound":10,"upperBound":20}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 2 supplied KPIs outside chosen thresholds.","rows":[{"id":"K1","label":"Response hours","value":8,"lowerBound":0,"upperBound":6,"status":"aboveThreshold","flagged":true,"distanceOutside":2},{"id":"K2","label":"Weekly reviews","value":10,"lowerBound":10,"upperBound":20,"status":"withinThreshold","flagged":false,"distanceOutside":0}],"warnings":["Only supplied figures and definitions are assessed. No data source connection, statistical inference or business outcome guarantee.","Flags reflect your explicit thresholds only. They do not estimate anomaly probability, causes or statistical significance."]}
